[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CyrusOne is a large scale data center provider headquartered in Dallas, Texas. In 2016 CyrusOne purchased the Chicago Mercantile Exchanges original Aurora, Illinois data center from CME Group for roughly 130 million dollars, with CME Group continuing to operate its Globex matching engine on site under a 15 year lease. In November 2021, KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire CyrusOne in an approximately 15 billion dollar deal, taking the company private, and that acquisition closed in 2022. CyrusOne has operated as a privately held company since, a company level ownership fact this registry had not previously recorded with a citable source. This specific row, PHX8, is one of five entries in this registry for this operators Chandler, Arizona campus on South Ellis Street. A datacentermap listing dedicated to PHX8, fetched fresh this session, gives 2705 South Ellis Street, Building 9, Chandler, Arizona 85286 as the street address. This row shares its street number with the neighboring PHX7 building but carries a distinct building number, Building 9 versus Building 10, which this session double checked via separate dedicated fetches for each to rule out a source mix up.

reading.body:
PHX8 is one building in a five-building CyrusOne campus on South Ellis Street in Chandler, Arizona with 169 MW of total IT capacity across all structures. The Chandler campus is the fifth largest published data center footprint in Arizona by capacity, representing roughly one-third of Arizona's 512 MW of publicly specified data center power. The facility holds TIA 942 Class 4 certification, indicating redundancy and fault tolerance appropriate for critical computing loads.

No individual power allocation for this building is published. At typical AI training density of 40 kW per rack, the 169 MW campus-wide figure suggests approximately 4,225 racks, though the distribution across five buildings is not disclosed. The 2 million square foot PHX8 building cannot be translated to IT load without knowing the operator's space utilization rate at this location.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities statewide but only four with published capacity figures in this registry. The Chandler campus represents a significant share of the state's disclosed infrastructure but sits in a state where most operational data center capacity remains unquantified. Whether PHX8 hosts AI workloads depends on tenant configuration, which is not published.
